purpose: Adapters for early Ypelaar cabinets and sets, nineteenth-century institutional collection formation, a transnational Australian slide box, NHM Thysanoptera digitisation and the Albert Mann diatom corpus. Science Museum Group rows reuse the existing smg_object_json_iiif adapter.
guards: Preserve early circular bone- or ivory-mounted microscopic preparations as historically specific slide/preparation formats rather than silently normalising them to later rectangular glass slides.
Do not convert original cabinet counts or later accession totals into current surviving counts without inventory evidence.
Keep human-remains catalogue classifications and child-record hierarchies intact for bounded anatomical slide cases.
Keep biological preparations, microphotographs, crude samples, negatives and lantern slides as separate media even when they survive in one collection or box.
A modern collection total does not establish a nineteenth-century slide subtotal; use labels, dates, accession records and publication-linked items to isolate the historical layer.

adapters.institution_scope: Rijksmuseum Boerhaave Abraham Ypelaar / Nicolaas van Staphorst cabinet
adapters.target: official museum story, signed handwritten catalogue and collection-catalogue endpoint
adapters.promotion_rule: Capture the original 800-specimen/19-drawer arrangement, Ypelaar attribution, Van Staphorst commission and purchase price; enumerate current surviving mounts only if the museum catalogue exposes them.

adapters.institution_scope: Yale Peabody Museum Lentz Collection Ypelaar microscope-slide set
adapters.target: Yale exhibition catalogue and eventual Peabody object record for the complete 24-slide set
adapters.promotion_rule: Preserve the complete 24-object set, circular ivory-mount format, signature, materials and specimen-origin metadata; distinguish current Lentz/Yale custody from original workshop production.

adapters.institution_scope: Royal College of Surgeons of Edinburgh early microscopic preparation collection
adapters.target: official museum history plus inventory discovery for preparations dating from 1850
adapters.promotion_rule: Preserve unknown maker status and only record Hamlin Lee as a qualified possibility; locate surviving inventory/preparation records before asserting glass-slide counts.

adapters.institution_scope: Powerhouse Museum H9118 prepared microscope-slide box
adapters.target: official object 255204 with individual slide descriptions and acquisition metadata
adapters.promotion_rule: Capture all nineteen positions where descriptions permit, including explicit 1860/1890/1892/1896/1898 dates and maker labels; keep microphotographs distinct from biological preparations and preserve 1974 gift as later custody.

adapters.institution_scope: Natural History Museum London Thysanoptera slide collection
adapters.target: official small-orders history plus 2022 complete slide-mounted Thysanoptera Data Portal dataset
adapters.promotion_rule: Use item labels, barcodes, collection dates, type status and accession metadata to identify the Francis Walker/pre-1875 layer; do not equate 112000 specimens with a slide count or historical subtotal.

adapters.institution_scope: Smithsonian / U.S. National Museum Albert Mann Diatom Collection
adapters.target: USNM annual report, Mann Albatross publications and Smithsonian Archives Mann/Conger records
adapters.promotion_rule: Retain the 8000-slide figure as the 1944 accession state, separate all other media, and isolate pre-1900 slides through 1894 mounted-specimen publications, 1899-1900 laboratory work, labels and archive records.
